description: This Java class `MessageHeadersBuilder` is a mutable builder for constructing immutable `MessageHeaders` objects in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a fluent API for setting header properties related to messaging, such as direction, thing ID, subject, timestamp, status code, and other custom headers. The class ensures mandatory headers are present and validates inputs. It supports creating instances from individual parameters, existing headers maps, or JSON objects and enforces consistency of header values.

classes.name: MessageHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating immutable MessageHeaders objects with a fluent API, ensuring mandatory headers are present and validated, and supporting various initialization methods.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder instance with specified message direction, thing ID, and subject. Deprecated version accepts CharSequence for thingId; current version requires a ThingId object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeadersBuilder initialized from a headers map or existing MessageHeaders object. Validates presence of mandatory headers.

methods.name: featureId
methods.description: Sets the feature ID header value.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME content type header.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp header using OffsetDateTime or ISO-8601 string.

methods.name: statusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code header using HttpStatusCode or integer.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable MessageHeaders object.
